text:
traffic_group
Description
This command returns the current traffic group. Useful for
troubleshooting the partitioning of data in the session table.
Syntax
traffic_group
Examples
when
RULE_INIT
{
log
local0.
"traffic_group name: [traffic_group]"
}
when
CLIENT_ACCEPTED
{
log
local0.
"traffic_group name: [traffic_group]"
}
